recommendation_summary: The agent recommends building a small local script now. It reads the client's code list and the job folder, matches each JPEG to its code exactly, writes the contact-sheet PDF in the client's order, and flags missing, duplicate or unmatched images. It treats a DAM or review portal only as a later option, if clients start asking to review online. It asks for a sample code list and filenames so it can check the list format and the separator after each code.
note: The bounded local script in client code order is the right recommendation, and the DAM is only a conditional later step, but the reply has none of the four required record lines.
